question: Should this PR's default `sessions_search` tool, `operator.read` `sessions.search` Gateway method, and lazy per-agent FTS index be accepted as the core transcript-search boundary for #100978?
rationale: The PR adds transcript-content discovery over persisted session state, so automation cannot choose the access scope, redaction contract, and index lifecycle without maintainer security/product intent.

options.title: Approve The Core Boundary
options.body: Accept `operator.read` transcript search with the current visibility filtering, redacted snippets, and indexed per-agent storage after reviewing the supplied proof.

options.title: Narrow The Search Surface
options.body: Require a tighter Gateway scope, caller policy, or target restriction before exposing transcript-content search broadly.

options.title: Defer Core Search
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want default core transcript search yet and leave #100978 as the decision record.

recommendation.title: Approve The Core Boundary
recommendation.body: Accept `operator.read` transcript search with the current visibility filtering, redacted snippets, and indexed per-agent storage after reviewing the supplied proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected feature issue and recently drove adjacent Gateway/session UX direction.
